name: SciBooNE
summary: SciBooNE measured sub-GeV neutrino interactions close to the Booster source, reusing the K2K SciBar tracker and supplying interaction and flux information relevant to MiniBooNE.
detection_principle: Fine extruded scintillator strips with wavelength-shifting-fibre readout reconstructed short charged-particle tracks. A downstream electromagnetic calorimeter and iron-scintillator muon range detector identified showers and measured muon range.

status.label: Completed / historical

key_parameters.name: Tracker
key_parameters.value: 15-ton SciBar plastic-scintillator detector; analysis fiducial masses are smaller

results.summary: Published an inclusive muon-neutrino charged-current interaction measurement on carbon, supporting interpretation of accelerator-neutrino samples.

science_scope: The record describes the named experiment as one programme; detector subsystems and repeated analyses are not counted as independent experiments.
